method: Differential testing of each validated patch that is not token-identical to the reference fix, against QuixBugs' correct version, on random inputs (2,000 per program; 300 for LEVENSHTEIN, whose naive recursion is exponential). Reproduce: python3 scripts/quixbugs.py difftest.

equivalent_on_random_inputs.GET_FACTORS: 0/2000 differ (trial division without the sqrt bound: correct, slower)
equivalent_on_random_inputs.QUICKSORT: 0/2000 differ (equal elements sent to the lower partition instead of the upper)

overfitted.FIND_IN_SORTED: 253/2000 differ, e.g. empty array: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of -1
overfitted.MERGESORT: 182/2000 differ, e.g. empty list: StackOverflowError instead of []
